title: Make Proposals proposal-first by collapsing maintenance run context
description:
Problem: the live `/proposals` review showed the route spending most first-viewport space on maintenance task controls and recent task activity before the actual proposal list/detail area. The detail placeholder is pushed to the bottom, and only a small slice of proposal rows is visible without scrolling.

Desired outcome: Proposals should prioritize proposal triage and review, while maintenance run controls and recent activity remain available as contextual secondary information.

Scope:
- In scope: collapse or relocate recent maintenance task activity, compact maintenance run controls, improve proposal list/detail proportions, and provide clearer empty/detail state affordances.
- Out of scope: changing proposal application semantics or maintenance task execution behavior.

Acceptance criteria:
- At narrow widths, proposal rows and the selected proposal/detail state occupy the primary first-viewport area.
- Recent maintenance activity is discoverable but does not dominate by default.
- Run maintenance controls are grouped as secondary route actions or a collapsible panel.
- Proposal triage actions remain reachable by keyboard and pointer.

Validation:
- Capture `/proposals` screenshots before/after with no selection and with a selected proposal.
- Run focused browser checks for filtering, selecting a proposal, collapsing context, and triggering maintenance controls.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Created from 2026-05-25 live visual review: `/proposals` currently reads as maintenance-run-first, leaving little first-viewport room for proposal triage and detail review.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Completed 2026-05-26: `/proposals` now collapses maintenance run controls and recent activity into a secondary `Maintenance context` panel, keeps filters and proposal rows visible by default, auto-collapses context when a proposal is selected, and adds an empty-state affordance to reopen the secondary panel when needed. Focused validation passed: `dotnet test C:\Users\norrt\source\repos\MemorySmith\MemorySmith.Tests\MemorySmith.Tests.csproj -c Release --filter "ProposalsMarkup_ShowsActiveRunAndKeepsActionBarHorizontalAtDesktopScale|ProposalsMarkup_ExplainsDisabledActionsAndPrioritizesReviewState|ProposalsMarkup_CollapsesMaintenanceContextForProposalFirstReview"` reported 3 passed, 0 failed. Browser validation in `artifacts/browser-validation/tsk-0126/20260526-125032-5re3212/` on `http://127.0.0.1:5122/proposals` confirmed a narrow no-selection state showed collapsed maintenance context plus visible proposal rows, selecting a proposal auto-collapsed context so summary/detail reclaimed the first viewport, reopening context exposed `Run Now`, `Run Task`, `Topic Map`, and recent activity as secondary controls, and clicking `Topic Map` succeeded with `Topic map refreshed.`. Screenshots: `proposals-narrow-no-selection-collapsed-context.png`, `proposals-narrow-selected-collapsed-context.png`, `proposals-narrow-selected-expanded-context.png`.
